minimum_requirement: Hourly or finer for at least 12 continuous months
preferred_requirement: 15-minute or finer for 3-5 years with meter and SCADA reconciliation
unit_or_format: MW and MWh with UTC timestamps
decision_use: Separate available resource from metered export and curtailment

data_item: Wind availability and turbine outage data
minimum_requirement: Interval plant availability and forced/planned outage flags
preferred_requirement: Per-turbine SCADA with availability definitions and event codes
unit_or_format: MW, percent and outage codes with UTC timestamps
decision_use: Derive available generation without confusing it with exported energy

minimum_requirement: Interval curtailment MW/MWh with cause and instruction ID
preferred_requirement: Reconciled against dispatch logs, settlement meters and invoices
unit_or_format: MW, MWh, cause, instruction ID and UTC timestamps
decision_use: Attribute curtailment and test whether solar could use spare export headroom

minimum_requirement: Executed connection agreement and documented active export limit
preferred_requirement: Time-varying limits and amendments with meter point identified

minimum_requirement: Approved load-flow, stability, protection and N-1 studies
preferred_requirement: Hybrid wind-plus-solar cases under normal and outage conditions
unit_or_format: Study files, assumptions and result tables
decision_use: Test deliverability and identify upgrade requirements

minimum_requirement: At least 12 months of outage/constraint history and planned works
preferred_requirement: Multi-year causes, durations and effect on available export
unit_or_format: UTC timestamps, MW and event descriptions
decision_use: Stress availability and export limit by interval

minimum_requirement: Current project schedule, approvals, scope and operating assumptions
preferred_requirement: Commissioning evidence and approved transfer/dispatch limits
decision_use: Include as a live grid case only after status and limits are verified

minimum_requirement: Native project version with coordinates and monthly outputs
preferred_requirement: Independent yield review with long-term correction and P50/P90 uncertainty
unit_or_format: PVsyst native file, report and source weather data
decision_use: Validate annual energy and modelled solar_available_mw

minimum_requirement: Source provider, period, coordinates and quality checks
preferred_requirement: Multi-year hourly GHI, DNI, DHI, temperature and wind at site with long-term correction
unit_or_format: Hourly meteorological series with UTC timestamps
decision_use: Establish weather provenance and seasonal/interannual risk

minimum_requirement: DC/AC sizing, module, inverter, tilt, orientation, shading and loss diagram
preferred_requirement: Hourly output for matched years with degradation, availability and clipping
unit_or_format: MWp, MWac, percent and hourly MW
decision_use: Convert irradiation into defensible net output

minimum_requirement: Relevant clauses on seller, buyer, energy definition, dispatch and curtailment
preferred_requirement: Full contract plus consent/licence and legal review
unit_or_format: Executed contract and amendments with authorised access
decision_use: Check whether any rights can apply to solar

data_item: Solar revenue route and term sheet
minimum_requirement: Written confirmation of buyer route, tariff, term and asset coverage
preferred_requirement: Indicative or approved term sheet and draft PPA with security
unit_or_format: USD/MWh or KES/kWh, tenor and payment terms
decision_use: Calculate contracted solar revenue and payment risk

minimum_requirement: Payment security, remedies, deemed-energy rules, allocation and exclusions
preferred_requirement: Executed clauses plus buyer credit evidence and settlement examples
unit_or_format: LC, escrow or guarantee terms, legal documents and settlement records
decision_use: Model cash-flow certainty and downside revenue

minimum_requirement: Itemised estimate for bay, metering, protection, upgrades and shared assets
preferred_requirement: Contractor/owner quotations and agreed cost allocation
unit_or_format: USD or KES estimate by scope and schedule
decision_use: Quantify whether shared infrastructure creates net savings

minimum_requirement: Indicative CAPEX with scope, taxes, duties, contingency and development costs
preferred_requirement: Competitive quotes and draft EPC/O&M contracts
unit_or_format: USD or KES by package and payment timing
decision_use: Build project cost and downside cases

minimum_requirement: Annual OPEX plus major maintenance, inverter replacement and shared services
unit_or_format: USD or KES per year and escalation

minimum_requirement: Indicative rate, currency, tenor, fees, grace and repayment profile
preferred_requirement: Lender term sheet including DSRA, covenants and hedge terms
unit_or_format: Term sheet with currency and date convention
decision_use: Size debt and test DSCR, LLCR and equity returns
